notes: Station is named for the creek but the table gives reservoir gage height and contents and discharge reaching the reservoir computed from storage, draft, spill and evaporation: typed Reservoir by the inflow-at-reservoir rule (Stream Discharge is arguable). 13 printed month-end rows (Sept. 30, 1965 to Sept. 30, 1966); first row has only gage height and contents. Counted gage height 13 + contents 13 + draft 12 + evaporation 12 + spill plus leakage 12 + discharge 12 = 74. 'other' = draft and spill plus leakage. Page also says on face of Sutherland Dam, 1.6 miles upstream from Black Canyon Creek and 7 miles northeast of Ramona.
